chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a young boy who urinates on a garment. He said: Pour a little water over it, then wring it out.

key_terms.تَعْصِرُهُ: you wring it out after washing

ai.seo_question: How should a garment be purified if a young boy urinates on it according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding purification of a garment affected by the urine of a young boy. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that a small amount of water be poured over the affected area and then the garment be wrung out, indicating a practical rule in ritual purity.
